name: 16066 · Cranberry Twp, PA
findings: ZIP 16066 (Cranberry Twp) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16066 (Cranberry Twp) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
